title: Whole Eight Dorsal Valves and Broad Oval Girdle Chiton
description: One wholly newly authored static chiton-like mollusc exterior at approximately nine-centimetre display length. Eight complete dorsal shell valves, including narrower anterior and posterior end valves and six intermediate arched saddles, sit embedded within one broad continuous oval girdle. A whole broad muscular foot occupies the underside, with a reduced eyeless head beneath the anterior girdle. No cephalic eyes, jointed side legs, antennae, crustacean tailfan or carved fossil slab is present. All valve outlines, cross-sections, body/girdle profiles and ventral forms are new; no old isopod domain geometry, removed limbs or changed segment-count shell is reused. One complete animal prop, zero scenes, four muted opaque solid PBR roles. Valves are closed solid stylizations and the finite sole is a resting datum. This is not a measured species, microscopic shell eyes, spines, scales, gill fringe, radula, complete internal anatomy, adhesion, locomotion, rolling defence, feeding, edibility identification, physical-stability simulation, rig or animation claim.
